name: Csipkerek (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of yellow over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Csipkerek: a blue shield with a bunch of grapes, a sheaf of grain and a ploughshare, within a green wreath, above a yellow scroll inscribed CSIPKEREK.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Csipkerek arms with wreath and scroll
